reason: I already spend time going through my card statement to sort out where the money went, so a tool that fills the categories in for me is worth 69 baht. I would try the free trial to see if it actually saves time before paying.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the app is half-empty and I'm back to typing things in myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the statement import got my rows wrong often enough that I had to fix most of them by hand, I would stop using it.
